SYMPTOM: Took edibles (Friday March 28) while on Concerta — full ADHD scatter returned, working memory gone, couldn't hold last 3 steps in head.

CAUSE: Concerta trying to focus the brain, THC scattering it. They fight each other and THC wins. Weed specifically impairs working memory, which is already an ADHD vulnerability.

FIX: Don't combine them. Simple.

DECISION: Ned decided no more weed. 'Had a blast but memory cost too high.' Saturday was productive chaos (built Stremio addon in 36 mins) but also lost most of the day to scattered hyperfocus.

GOTCHA: Edibles from Friday still affecting Saturday's Concerta efficacy. Residual THC degrades the medication window.
